## Synopsis

```text
perch mail [OPTIONS] COMMAND
```

## Description

The mail command group is a scriptable IMAP and SMTP client. list, search, and fetch talk IMAP; send talks SMTP; caps prints the SMTP EHLO extensions of a submission server.

Credentials and TLS flags are shared. IMAP flags are local to list/search/fetch; SMTP flags are local to send/caps.

## Notes

- If --server or --smtp-server is omitted, the matching listener is taken from --config.
- Use --plaintext or --smtp-plaintext only for trusted loopback listeners.
- Password sources: --password-file, --password-stdin, PERCH_IMAP_PASSWORD, or an interactive prompt.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--username, -u <value>` | account username (env PERCH_IMAP_USER) |
| `--password <value>` | account password (prefer PERCH_IMAP_PASSWORD or --password-file) |
| `--password-file <value>` | read the account password from a file |
| `--password-stdin` | read the account password from stdin |
| `--timeout <value>` | connection timeout (default: 30s) |
| `--config <value>` | configuration file (default: ~/.config/perch/perch.yaml) |
| `--help, -h` | show help |

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [perch mail list](perch-mail-list.md) | list mailboxes |
| [perch mail search](perch-mail-search.md) | search message metadata |
| [perch mail fetch](perch-mail-fetch.md) | fetch raw messages |
| [perch mail send](perch-mail-send.md) | compose and send a message |
| [perch mail caps](perch-mail-caps.md) | show the SMTP extensions advertised by a submission server |

## Examples

```sh
perch mail list --server imaps://mail.example.com --username you@example.com

perch mail search -q 'unseen from:alice' --json

perch mail fetch -q 'from:alice' --format mbox > alice.mbox

perch mail send --from you@example.com --to alice@example.com \
  --subject Hello --body 'Hi Alice'
```

## Environment

| Variable | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `PERCH_IMAP_USER` | default account username |
| `PERCH_IMAP_PASSWORD` | account password |
